profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: I am a Software Engineer specializing in API integrations and web application development, with a strong background in technologies like C#, .NET, SQL Server, MongoDB, React, Node.js, and Python. My passion lies in solving complex technical challenges and transforming ideas into innovative solutions that enhance user experiences and drive business efficiency. I have experience working both independently and collaboratively in agile environments, consistently delivering high-quality results and meeting tight deadlines.
